title: Platinum Prime Pack
description: a modpack for the wonderful people over at Platinum Entertainment!
body:
Platinum Prime Pack is a modpack dedicated to the people at Platinum Entertainment!

This pack contains mods for 
- Create, Mekanism and Oritech, (technically cool)
- Iron's Spells, (wizard dudes)
- Dungeons, (for the adventuring kind)
- Apotheosis, etc. (more wizard dudes!)

and this pack is based on Create Chronicles who we've found very fun but wanted to make it a little more goofy without breaking the fragile structure of minecraft modpacks!

This modpack will get updated from time to time in response to new versions of mods and modifications to the game as time goes on and new mods get updated!

and if you're outside the PE server, then feel free to play with your own server! <3
